notes: Precision/recall/F1 curves for the classification test exist only in Fig. 4 (not extractable); FastOmniTMAE is only said to stay 'above 0.6' F1. IMDb is used only for the update_p dynamics plot (Fig. 2b), no quality result. Table 2 CPU-row RG65 rho 0.680 is printed without SD while the caption says mean over 5 runs; it differs from Table 1 CPU RG65 rho 0.656 because Table 2 uses 8,000 examples per token on a 44-token workload. The paper calls RG65 '44 word pairs' / '44-token workload' (standard RG-65 has 65 pairs). clauses_scope left not_reported: CoTM clauses shared across outputs, yet Omni TM-AE is 'trained separately for each target token'. embedding_dim 40000 is inferred (not printed in this paper). Fig. 2(c) shows clause weights over epochs; Fig. 5 t-SNE of 13 semantic groups (embeddings from the Table 1 setup).
